description: MainActivity.java is an Android Java source file that defines the MainActivity class, which is a subclass of SampleActivityBase. It sets up the user interface with a fragment and handles menu interactions to toggle a log view, as well as initializing logging components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a fragment and manages a log toggle feature in the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the view, and adds a fragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures menu item visibility and titles based on internal state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, primarily toggling the log view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging system, connecting various log components.
